arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
import subprocess, time, resource, sys, os, json
from collections import Counter
def limit():
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (768*1024*1024, 768*1024*1024))
start = time.time()
with open("/app/tmp/mem.json","rb") as f, open("/app/tmp/mem.out","wb") as o:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "entry.py"], stdin=f, stdout=o, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, preexec_fn=limit)
el = time.time() - start
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print("rc:", p.returncode, "wall: %.2fs" % el, "cpu: %.2fs" % (ru.ru_utime + ru.ru_stime), "maxrssMB: %.1f" % (ru.ru_maxrss/1024))
print("stderr:", p.stderr[:300])
if p.returncode == 0:
    d = json.load(open("/app/tmp/mem.out"))
    r = d["results"][0]
    print("statuses:", Counter(x["status"] for x in r["packets"]))
    print("conn:", r["connection"]["state"], "streams:", len(r["streams"]), "rt:", r["received_total"])
EOF
